name: 83 Weeks
Text: Can be played as if it is D: 0. Shuffle up to 8 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw up to 3 cards. When this card is in your Ring, discard 1 less card to change Enforcers with Controversy Creates Cash.

name: A Legendary Legion
Text: You are a WWF Classic Superstar and considered to be The Road Warriors for Legendary Offense, and your 'Classic' maneuvers are also BASH maneuvers for your effects. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 card in your hand, and your opponent puts 2 random cards from their hand on the bottom of their Arsenal and draws 1 card. When you successfully play a 'Doom' maneuver, you may reveal Spiked Armor.

name: A Puncher's Chance
Text: Packed: you cannot pack Very European or Brass 'Nuks' Shot. When your opponent would overturn for your other non-damage card effects, they may overturn 0 instead. When your non-Chain, non-Volley, non-RMS 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Hook', 'Uppercut', 'Haymaker', or 'Jab' Strike is unsuccessful, they overturn # (# = number of Ringside 'Punch', 'Fist', 'Hook', 'Uppercut', 'Haymaker', or 'Jab' cards, max 3).

name: A Triple Threat
Text: Packed: you are also an ECW and WCW Superstar. Your 'Classic' maneuvers count as non-Unique for Asbury Park, New Jersey;  your Superstar-specific cards are also WCW; and you may play 1 Allegiance card and/or Asbury Park, New Jersey during the Events phase.

name: Abby the Witch
Text: When successful, put this card into your opponent's Backstage. Replace 'hand' in Bray Wyatt's Ability with 'hand or Ring'. When your opponent is The Fiend, you cannot reverse Sister Abigail from Arsenal.

name: Action Movie Icon
Text: When packing this card, you may pack up to 10 Movie cards in your Backstage; when this card is revealed, shuffle those cards into your Arsenal. When your Movie card is unsuccessful, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your turn, you may hide this card and shuffle any number of Movie cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Adam Cole
Text: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may RFG 1 card in your hand and then you may play your next reversal as if it was a hybrid, non-hybrid, Unique, and/or played from Backlash.  When you Promo, you may put up to 2 cards not chosen on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your Redemption is blank.

name: Adam Cole BAYBAY
Text: As an action, shuffle this card into your Arsenal. As a reversal, shuffle up to 4 RFG cards into your Arsenal.

name: Aleister Black
Text: Your opponent's Fortitude Rating is considered -6F for playing reversals to your Superstar-specific cards. Your Sit Right Here and Bide My Time is Unique, not Smackdown, and replace ‘if...a card’ with ‘Once during each of your turns’. Face, Heel, Cheater, and Fan Favorite cards can only be packed in your Backstage Area. You can pack High-Flying Style, but you cannot pack Wrestlemania.

name: All About Eve
Text: When Diva Bikini Contest is in your Ring, you may choose both options for effects on this card. When you successfully play an 'Eve' card, choose one: he overturns 1 card, or put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you reveal a Unique card for your Ability, choose one: RFG 1 card in your Ringside and put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, OR your next card played this turn is -1D and +1 Stun Value. Your 'Diva' cards are considered to have 'diva' in the text for your effects.

name: An Olde School Auditor
Text: Arsenal Search The Artiste's Auditory Ability and put it in your Ring; once during each of your turns, you may shuffle it into your Arsenal and then Arsenal Search 1 'Classic' maneuver. Your 'Classic' maneuvers are considered non-Unique for your effects when searching your Arsenal, double the numbers in their text, ignore their 'Can be reversed...' text when you have equal or lower Fortitude, and when they are unsuccessful, your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal (when you have lower Fortitude, 2 random cards).

name: And Now I'm Calling You Out
Text: Shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When you have a Face or Fan Favorite card in your Ring, your opponent reveals his hand and you choose 1 maneuver or action. During his next turn, the chosen card must be his first card played or he ends his turn. When you have a Heel or Cheater card in your Ring, he overturns 6 cards.

name: And the Crowd goes Wild!
Text: When packing this card your I Have a Major Announcement is Unique. Can only be played when I Have a Major Announcement is in your Ring. When you have equal or lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot reverse its Activated Card Effect. When your non-Unique non-Superstar-specific maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal instead of any other location.

name: Apron Bomb
Text: When you have a Superstar-specific card in your Backstage with 'Bomb' in the title or text, or you are Kevin Owens, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead. Can only be played as a Counter (Arsenal) or if Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring. Discard 2 cards and your opponent discards 5 cards.

name: Are You Ready For a Good Time?
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Smackdown Cannot be packed by Eddie Guerrero, or when packing Enforcers, Boston, Massachusetts, Backed by Smackdown GM Vickie Guerrero, or more than 1 copy of This is Just the Beginning (it is Active, and before each of your opponent's Draw Segments you may put that card from any area into your Backlash.) Discard and overturn 1 less card to activate your Allegiance. Your Smackdown actions are considered 2D Strike, Grapple, and Submission maneuvers with 1 Stun for your Smackdown High Risks.

name: Arise From The Shadows
Text: Cannot be blanked, and can be played during any Pre-match phase. Your Aleister Black-specific cards do not take up slots in your Ring. When your opponent plays a Backlash card that is Face, Heel, Cheater, or Fan Favorite, he puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you successfully play a Heel or Cheater card, Ringside Search 1 card and put 1 card from your hand at the bottom of your Arsenal. When you successfully play a Face or Fan Favorite card, he randomly discards 1 card and draws 1 card.

name: Asuka's Audacious Assault
Text: When your maneuver listed on Asuka's Aggression is reversed and you have lower Fortitude, you may put this card from your Ringside or Backlash into your Ring. When Kabuki Warriors is not in your Ring, you have not played any cards during your turn, and you have 5+ lower Fortitude, you may play a maneuver listed on Asuka's Aggression with another maneuver listed on Asuka's Aggression. Unless both are reversed from hand or Backlash, both are successful.

name: Au Revoir
Text: As a maneuver, cannot be reversed from Arsenal when Vive La Résistance! is in your Ring. As an action, this card is -35F; shuffle this card into your Arsenal, and put 1 card from your Backstage into your Backlash. As a reversal, this card is F: 0; completely reverse any Activated Card Effect or Multi card. when played, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal instead of any other area.

name: Ax and Smash
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +4D, and -2D for each reversal played in response. As a reversal, reverse any card that would allow your opponent to search their Arsenal.

name: Backed by Luna Vachon
Text: # = total Stun Value in your Ring. This card is -#F, shuffle up to # cards from your Ringside and up to 3 RFG cards into your Arsenal, and draw up to 2 cards. ACE: During your turn, you may RFG this card and your opponent overturns # cards (max 8).

name: Beat You Raw
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw. When this card is unsuccessful, your opponent overturns # (# = your Raw Ring cards, max 5).

name: Big Bubba Steps In
Text: You may Promo: 3 and shuffle up to 3 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. Your opponent overturns 3 cards.

name: Big Daddy V Drop
Text: When you have 30F+ this card is +10D and a Trademark Finisher instead. Your opponent RFGs 2 random cards in his hand, and RFG the top 2 cards from his Arsenal. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may shuffle it and up to 1 card in your Ringside into your Arsenal, and put up to 1 Set-up card in your Ringside into your hand.

name: Bigelow's Double Underhook Backbreaker
Text: This card is considered to be a Foreign Object with 'Classic' in the title for your effects. Your opponent puts 2 cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, Greetings From Asbury Park cannot be reversed from Arsenal by non-Unique cards.

name: Black Hole Sun
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F; draw up to 1 card, shuffle up to 6 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and your opponent RFG the top card of his Arsenal. As a reversal, completely reverse any Multi card, and he shuffles the reversed card into his Arsenal. When successful, you may Promo: 2.

name: Black Mass
Text: Can only be reversed by a reversal card. As a maneuver, when played you may RFG up to 6 cards in your Ring; for each removed card, your opponent's Fortitude Rating is considered -2F for reversals to this card. When this card is unsuccessful, he discard 1 random card. As a reversal, discard this card, and he overturns 6 cards. When this card is in your Ringside and your opponent ends his turn without playing a maneuver, put Black Mass into your hand.

name: Black's Barrage
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -6F and your opponent must discard 1 card to play reversals to it. During your turn when this card is in your Ringside, you may either overturn 6 cards or RFG 6 cards in your Ringside and then put it in your hand.

name: Bless Your Heart
Text: As an action, shuffle any cards with 'Female' or 'Diva' in the text from your Ringside into your Arsenal. As a reversal, reverse any #D- maneuver, where # equals twice the number of cards under your Superstar card. Ringside Search 1 card. Your next card played can be played from under your Superstar card as if from hand (or Backlash, if applicable.)

name: Blindside Aggression
Text: When your 'Blindside' maneuver is reversed, put this card from your hand or Ringside into your Ring. When you would remove cards in your Ringside for your non-Superstar-specific 'Blindside' reversals, instead put one of those cards into your hand. Your 'Blindside' maneuvers are Cheater, ignore the 'When played...' text on your maneuvers with the same title as a card under this card, and your opponent cannot play D: 2+ reversals to them. When it is successful, put this card into your Ringside.

name: Blood Moon Stomp
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after From The Top Rope. When played after From The Top Rope, your opponent's reversals with ‘Multi’ in the text are blank until the end of the turn. When this card is in your Ring, your Black Mass cannot be reversed from Arsenal by non-Unique reversals.

name: Bobby Fish
Text: When you Promo, you may put 0 cards into your hand; if you do, put the cards not chosen and up to 1 RFG card (except Divine Intervention)on the bottom of your Arsenal and then draw 1 card.

name: Bobby's Mouthpiece
Text: Reveal this card when Bobby Fish is revealed. When Bobby Fish is hidden, hide this card. Your opponent's maneuvers are -1D, his Strike maneuvers are an additional -1D, and when you successfully play a Trademark Finisher you may Promo: 2. When you are Undisputed Era and your Fortitude is 30+, or when you are Bobby Fish, your Unique printed 15D+ Submissions are Trademark Finishers instead.

name: Book 'em, Dango!
Text: When you are Fandango, this card is -10F. When Breezango is in your Ring, this card is -5F. As an action, -5F; your opponent cannot respond to this card when you have 5+ lower Fortitude; draw up to 3 cards and your next maneuver played this turn cannot be reversed from hand. When successful, he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal; when you are Fandango, 2 random cards instead.

name: BOOM!
Logos: Undisputed Era, Adam Cole, Roderick Strong, Kyle O'Reilly, Bobby Fish
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you are Undisputed Era, your NXT Title Belts do not take up slots in your Ring. When you RFG a Superstar-specific card, you may instead put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal. Once during your turn, when you successfully play a Superstar-specific card or a maneuver as a Counter, you may Promo: 3; Bobby Fish may do this once during any turn.

name: Breezango
Text: Cannot be blanked or prevented from being played by your opponent. Can be played from Ringside. When packing this card, you can pack cards as if you are an NXT Superstar. When NXT Tag Team Title Belts is in your Ring, your Starting Hand Size is +1 and his Starting Hand Size is -1. Before your first Draw Segment, he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. Once during each of your turns, and when he Promos, you may put 1 card from your hand or Ringside under The Fashion Files.

name: Brutal Blindside Beating
Text: Can be played from Ringside. Can only be played when you have lower Fortitude, with a printed F: 0 'Blindside' maneuver from your Ringside (when Blindside Aggression is in your Ring, up to 2 printed F: 0 'Blindside' maneuvers). Ignore 'when played...' in their text, and your opponent cannot play D: 1+ reversals to them.  Unless all maneuvers are reversed when played, all are successful.

name: Camp Cornette
Logos: British Bulldog, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. When packing this card, you are a WWF Classic Superstar, but you cannot pack The Hart Family, Strength of Allied Powers or Managed by Harley Race. When your opponent successfully played a maneuver during the previous turn, ignore 'Can only be played...' text on your first non-Run-in maneuver of each turn. When you play an 'Interfere' card, draw up to 1 card and your opponent discards 1 random card.

name: Carrying All the Gold
Text: When packing this card, you can pack 3 Title Belts without 'diva' or 'female' in the text in your Backstage, but you cannot pack First Of All or Title Belts in your Backlash. When you are the Four Horsemen, you can only pack 'WCW' or 'United States' Title Belts.  When you are Undisputed Era, you can only pack 'NXT' Title Belts and ignore the 'When you are Seth... those' text. When you are Evolution, you can only pack Raw Title Belts. When this card is revealed, reveal any Title Belts in your Backstage, and at the end of the Pre-match phase, put those cards into your Ring.

name: Charlotte's Spear
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -20F and +5D, and cannot be reversed by hybrid cards; when you have 40F+, this card is a Trademark Finisher instead of a Strike. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver or non-Superstar-specific action. Your opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Chic and Destroy
Text: As an action, you may put up to 1 card in your opponent's Ring into his Ringside; when Breezango is in your Ring, draw up to 1 card. As a reversal, reverse a non-Superstar-specific card and he discards 1 random card. When this card is in your Ring and your opponent Promos, he then discards 1 random card.

name: Classic Gorilla Press Slam
Text: When you do not have a 'Power' maneuver in your Ring, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. This card is also considered Press Slam for your effects. Put 1 card in any player's Ring into their Ringside.

name: Classic Judo Chop
Text: When you are not Ric Flair, can be reversed as if it was non-Unique. Choose 1: your opponent randomly discards 1 Backlash card, or during his next turn he cannot play non-Unique maneuvers.

name: Classic Snap Suplex
Text: Unless you are Tazz, or have a Kurt Angle-specific card in your Ring, can be reversed as if it is non-Unique. When you have a Heat card in your Ringside, this card is Heat. During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside, you may discard 1 'Classic' or 'Plex' maneuver to put this into your hand. Arsenal Search 1 'Classic' or 'Suplex' card.

name: Claymore Kick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -10F and your opponent cannot reduce the damage of this card. As a reversal, reverse any Grapple or non-Superstar-specific action. When successfully played, draw up to 1 card, and your opponent discards 2 random cards; if he does not, he overturns 3 cards.

name: Cole Calls it Right!
Text: When your opponent has a Feud in his Ring, he cannot respond to this card. When he plays a maneuver listed on a Feud in his Ring he may discard 2 cards. If he does not, it is -1D for each maneuver in his Ring with a title printed on his Feud.

name: Cole's Superkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is +4D. When played after a successful maneuver, cannot be reversed by cards with 'Search' in the text, and when successful, Arsenal Search Panama Sunrise. As an action, this card is -4F and if reversed, put it in your hand regardless of other effects; shuffle it into your Arsenal and then put 1 RFG card into your hand.

name: Cole's Trademark Resiliency
Text: This card is -2F for each of your RFG cards.  Can only be played after a successful maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and damage until the end of the turn, and end his turn. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may reveal an NXT card from your hand, and then put it on the bottom of your Arsenal and Promo: 3.

name: Corner Charge Strike
Text: When DIY is not in your Ring, this card is -4F and when it is unsuccessful, discard 1 card and put up to 2 maneuvers from your Ringside into your hand.

name: Cornette Interferes
Logos: British Bulldog, Jim Cornette, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: When you are not Jim Cornette or Yokozuna, can only be played when Camp Cornette is in your Ring; when it is, this card is -7F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific card and your opponent overturns 2 cards.

name: Cornette's Motivational Speech
Logos: British Bulldog, Jim Cornette, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: When you are not Jim Cornette or Yokozuna, can only be played when Camp Cornette is in your Ring; when it is, this card is -7F and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards. As an action, shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal and draw up to 3 cards. When successful, Ringside Search 1 card.

name: Cornette's Ringside Support
Logos: British Bulldog, Owen Hart, Vader, Yokozuna
Text: Requirement: Camp Cornette is in your Ring. When your opponent successfully played a maneuver during the previous turn, he cannot respond to this card. Ringside Search up to 2 non-hybrid maneuvers, and he puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws 1 card. When this card is RFG or in your Ringside and his maneuver is successful, put this card into your Backlash.

name: Counter Assault
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Revolution of the Mind or Legendary Defense. When the played maneuver is not Superstar-specific, this card can reverse as if it is D: 0. When overturned as a reversal, this counts as 2 reversals and put this card in your Ring.

name: Counter Hold
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Revolution of the Mind or Legendary Defense. When the played maneuver is not Superstar-specific, this card can reverse as if it is D: 0. When overturned as a reversal, this counts as 2 reversals and put this card in your Ring.

name: Counter Throw
Text: Cannot be packed when packing A Revolution of the Mind or Legendary Defense. When the played maneuver is not Superstar-specific, this card can reverse as if it is D: 0. When overturned as a reversal, this counts as 2 reversals and put this card in your Ring.

name: Day One Ish
Text: Can only be reversed by 1 reversal card. Draw up to 1 card and put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and your opponent must RFG 1 card in his hand. When choosing options for The Kings of Double Teams, you may also choose the option 'when successfully played, put 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal', and you may choose 1 additional option.

name: Dean's Single Leg Lock
Text: As a maneuver, reversals to this card are +12F and -4D. As a reversal, reverse any Submission or Multi card. When successfully played, Arsenal Search 1 'Cloverleaf' card.

name: Digging Holes and Takin' Souls
Text: When you reveal your Backstage cards, put this card from your Backlash into your Ring. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3.When you are about to lose the game via Count Out, you may Activate Wrestlemania as if losing by Pinfall Victory.ACE: Once during each of your turns when you have lower Fortitude, you may RFG 1 card in your hand or Ringside, and then your opponent cannot play reversals from hand to your next Superstar-specific card this turn. Reversals to this effect do not end your turn.

name: DIY
Text: Cannot be blanked or blocked. Can be played from Ringside. At the end of the Pre-match phase, hide The Sicilian Psychopath and Rebel Heart. Counts as The Sicilian Psychopath for your effects. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, Bury 1 'Technical', Face, Heel, or random Ringside card; your opponent randomly reveals 2 Hand cards.

name: Do It Yourself
Text: Arsenal / Ringside Search 2 non-Unique non-reversal maneuvers and Nobody Will Do It For You. When DIY is in your Ring, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when it is not and this card is unsuccessful, your turn does not end.

name: Dragonslayer
Text: When played, you may overturn 6 cards. If you do, this card can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Your opponent puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, and shuffle up to 6 random cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your Black Mass cannot be reversed from hand by hybrid reversals.

name: Dunne's Four-Star Forearm
Text: As a maneuver, +4D.  Your opponent's reversals to your next card played this turn are +4F. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique Strike. Draw up to 4 cards and then put the same number of cards from your hand and up to that many Ringside cards on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Dunne's Step Up Ensugiri
Text: As a maneuver, -5F and +3D, and when played after a successful maneuver, this card is a High Risk instead. As a reversal, can only be played when your opponent successfully plays a maneuver. After damage is applied, end the turn.

name: Emma's Body Scissors
Text: When you have 8+ lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0; when it is Multi, it cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals. You may randomly discard 1 card; if you do, your opponent randomly discards 1 card. When this card is in your Ringside and he successfully plays a maneuver, you may discard 1 card and put this card into your hand.

name: Emma's Effervescent Entrance
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, put up to 5 cards from your hand on the bottom of your Arsenal, and draw the same number of cards. When you randomly discard cards, you may overturn 2 cards and put 1 of those discarded cards under this card. Cards under this card may be played as if from hand. When you hide Emma’s Bubbly Personality, put all cards under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and hide this card.

name: End of Heartache
Text: When you are Undisputed Era this card is -5F and -5D. Reverse any 'Breaker' card. When Roderick Strong is revealed, can also reverse any Grapple.

name: Eve's Single-Leg Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -7F, and when played as a Counter or after a maneuver, this card is a High Risk instead. As a reversal, reverse any Chain, Heat, or Volley card. When revealed for your Ability or overturned for your Eve-specific effects, your opponent overturns 1 card.

name: Eve's Triangle Hold
Text: When your opponent is not a Diva, can only be reversed by Unique reversals. Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuver. When this card is in your Ringside, you may overturn 3 cards and then put it in your hand.

name: Everyday I'll Fight to Be Legendary
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw When played you may discard 1 Raw card and your opponent cannot respond to this card. Shuffle any number of RFG 'Coach' cards into your Arsenal. ACE: When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put this card into your Ringside and your turn does not end.

name: Eviscerating Chop
Text: Cannot be reversed by Elbow to the Face. When played after Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, can be played from Ringside. Draw 2 cards, and your opponent shuffles 1 card from his hand into his Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, your Viscera-specific maneuvers are also considered Grapples for your effects, and when played as a Counter, ignore the 'Can only be played...'.

name: Extreme Promo Skills
Text: As an action, F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to this card. As a reversal, can only be played after a successfully played maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text until the end of turn; when that maneuver is a non-Superstar-specific Foreign Object, it is D: 0. After damage has been applied, end his turn. ACE: During his turn when he plays a card, you may put this card in your Ringside and then ignore all modifications to that card from his card effects until the end of the turn.

name: Fight For What's Right
Text: Cannot be packed when packing nWo or WCW cards. Cannot be blanked. Your Superstar-specific cards are considered Fan Favorite, and your Hulkamania: Always in Style do not take up slots in your Ring. Cards listed in your Ability are considered to have 'Classic' in the title, and cannot be reversed by non-Unique cards from hand or Backlash. When Hulk Rules is revealed, your 'Classic' maneuvers are -7F.

name: Fight For Your Dreams
Text: Cannot be packed when packing 'A.J.' cards. Reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver and draw up to 2 cards; when you drew 2 cards, your opponent puts the reversed maneuver into his hand or Backlash (if applicable).

name: Fight For Your Life!
Text: Cannot be packed when packing nWo cards. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Can only be played after your opponent successfully plays a 5D+ maneuver; after damage is applied, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand and end his turn. When you have lower Fortitude, do not discard for your Ability, and before each of your Draw Segments, choose 1: he cannot play non-Unique reversals to your first Superstar-specific card this turn, or he cannot play reversals to your first Superstar-specific card Activated this turn. When he moves this card from your Ring, he discards 2 random cards, and you may reveal Feathered Boa.

name: First WWE Women's Tag Team Champions
Text: Cannot be reversed by non-Unique reversals when WWE Women's Tag Team Title Belts is in your Ring. Draw up to 2 cards, put up to 1 card from your Ringside into your hand, and put up to 7 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. Your opponent's Mid-match Capacity is -1.

name: Flexy Lexy
Text: Reverse any card that would move a card from your Ring; when you have no 'Striker' cards in your Ring, can also reverse any non-Trademark Finisher maneuver. When this card is in your Ring and you have lower Fortitude, replace 'maneuver' with 'card' in your No Sell Maneuver.

name: Friends of the Frenchman
Text: When packing this card, you may pack reversals as if they are not Face or Heel. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing your Superstar-specific Pre-match cards, and they can be played from Ringside. You may RFG 4 Ringside cards to Activate Vive La Résistance! instead of moving that card; if you do, you cannot Activate it again this turn, and only a non-hybrid reversal can be moved from your Ring with this effect. When he plays a maneuver, you may discard 1 card and overturn 1 card, and then choose one: it is not Multi; you may play a hybrid reversal as if it is not hybrid (it deals no damage); OR you may play a D: 1 reversal as if it is D: 0.

name: From Bracket Busters to Champions
Text: When DIY and NXT Tag Team Title Belts are in your Ring, your Hand Size is +1 and your opponent's Hand Size is -1. Your NXT Title Belts do not take up a Ring slot. When you are Johnny Gargano and DIY is in your Ring: ignore 'Superstar-specific' in your Ability, replace the Superstar listed on Headstrong with 'Johnny Gargano', and before your first Draw Segment, put Johnny Takeover from any area into your Ring.

name: From Sydney, Australia
Text: Cannot be blanked. You may play this card during the Venue phase. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. Once during any turn, when you discard any number of cards, you may put 1 of those cards on the bottom of your Arsenal instead. After overturning 1+ IICONICS! for your opponent's effect or while taking damage, choose 1: put 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal OR he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draws 1.

name: From Truth or Consequences
Text: Your opponent may choose to play with his hand revealed, if he does not, he overturns 1 card before each of his Draw Segments. Your non-reversal Superstar-specific cards are considered to have 'Hardcore' in the title, and your 'Hardcore' cards cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals. Discard 1 less card for The Hardcore Diaries and when that card is unsuccessfully Activated, he discards cards equal to half the number of cards under that card rounded down.

name: Glorious DDT
Text: Your opponent discards 4 cards.

name: Glorious Domination
Text: When your opponent draws for his Draw Segment, you may put this card into your Ring from your hand, Ringside or RFG. When you put this card into your Ring, you do not discard for his reversal restrictions, and during his next turn your reversals are considered D:0. When this card is in your Ring and he chooses to end his turn after successfully playing a maneuver, RFG this card.

name: Glorious Entrance
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. You start the game. Your Spectacular Ring Entrance! reads “Shuffle any number of cards from your hand into your Arsenal, then draw that many cards +1.” During any turn, when you would reveal your hand, you may first put up to 2 cards from your hand under this card; you may play cards under this card as if from hand. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 card under this card and then Arsenal Search 1 maneuver without a printed reversal restriction.

name: Glorious Has Arrived
Text: Cannot be reversed when you have 2- 'Glorious' cards in your Ring. Discard any number of Spectacular Ring Entrance! cards from your Backstage, and put any number of those cards from your Ring into your Ringside. Put cards from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside equal to the number of cards put into your Ringside with this effect. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may reveal your hand and the next card played this turn from under Glorious Entrance is blank.

name: Glorious Moustache
Logos: Robert Roode, Cody Rhodes, Rick Rude, Iron Sheik
Text: Cannot be packed by The Rhodes Brothers. When you are Robert Roode, this card is F: 2. When you are The Iron Sheik, this card is Heat. When you have lower Fortitude, overturn 1 less card for your Ability, and ignore the 'Set-up' text on Facebuster. When you successfully play a Triple H-specific card, draw up to 1 card; when it is unsuccessful, you may put it on the bottom of your Arsenal, your opponent discards 1 random card, and when it is an action, you may put it in your Ring instead.

name: Silent Contemplation
Text: When this card is your first non-Pre-match, non-Reversal card played of the game, this card is -12F and your opponent cannot respond to it. Discard up to 6 cards, and for every 2 cards discarded, Arsenal Search 1 non-Superstar-specific card. You are considered to have +6F when playing your next maneuver this turn, and it cannot be reversed from Backlash. During your turn, you may put this card from your Ring or Ringside into your Backlash and end your turn.

name: Sit Right Here and Bide My Time
Text: When you are Aleister Black, you may pack this card in your Backstage, and at the end of the Pre-match phase, put it in your Ring. When you are not, can only be packed when packing I Won't Be Denied! Cannot be blanked. If your turn ends and you did not successfully play a card, you may put 1 card from your Ringside under this card. ACE: During your turn you may RFG this card and put all cards under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, and then shuffle up to triple that many cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. When your opponent has 25+ greater Fortitude, this cannot be reversed.

name: Smack You Down
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Smackdown Can be packed by Female Superstars. When this card is unsuccessful and you unsuccessfully activate your Allegiance, do not discard for your opponent's reversal effect, and put this card into your Ring instead of any other location. When your next card played this turn is a High Risk, if it is successful, your opponent overturns 1 card for each non-Set-up Smackdown card in your Ring.

name: Smackdown GM Promotion
Text: Packed: you can pack Backed by Smackdown GM Vickie Guerrero, and pack 6- This is Just the Beginning in your Backstage. Once during each of your opponent's turns when they play a non-RMS maneuver, you may put 1 'Beginning' card from your Backstage into your Ring, and the played maneuver counts as a non-maneuver and an action for your Superstar-specific effects; when an action played with your Ability is unsuccessful, you may reverse their maneuver normally. When you play a non-Unique maneuver without a printed reversal restriction, you may overturn 3 and it counts as a Smackdown card for your effects. Your Fortitude is +1 for every non-Pre-match printed Smackdown card in your Ring.

name: Smackdown Women’s Championship Belt
Text: Can only be packed when packing The Era of the Superstar. When you successfully play a maneuver, put up to 1 action from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you successfully play a Set-up and your next card played that turn is a maneuver without 'reversed' in the text, it is +2D. Your Everyone Wants to Watch Women, Period cards are Multi. Superstar Value +1

name: Strong Hold
Text: This card is considered to be a non-Unique 'Breaker' Submission for your Superstar-specific effects. When you use your Superstar Ability and this card is in your Ringside, you may put it and 1 other card on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Strowman's Running Knockdown
Text: When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is -#F, where # is your opponent's Fortitude Rating. As a maneuver, +3D; when played as a Counter or after a successfully played maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand. As a reversal, reverse any card that would move cards from any player's Ringside.

name: Superkick
Text: This card is +10F, +10D and a Trademark Finisher when you have a Superstar-specific card in your Backstage with 'Kick' in the title or text.

name: Suplex on the Apron
Text: Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver or if Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring. When there are 10+ maneuvers in all players' Rings, can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Support from Dr. Shelby
Text: Overturn 6 cards and put up to 2 Ringside cards on the bottom of your Arsenal. During your first turn, put up to 2 Ringside cards into your hand. During your turn when you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, choose one: your first maneuver played each turn is considered Superstar-specific, or your next Superstar-specific card played this turn is considered to be played after a 5D maneuver. When your Fortitude Rating is 15+, during your opponent's turn he may discard 2 cards and overturn 2 cards; if he does, hide this card.

name: Swiss One Nine
Text: Can only be played after a successfully played maneuver or as a Counter (5D+ maneuver). Cannot be played after From the Top Rope. When played after a maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non-Unique cards. When The Bar is not in your Ring, draw up to 1 card.

name: Tap, Nap or Snap?
Text: As an action, Arsenal / Ringside Search 1 Submission. If that card is the next card played, it can only be reversed from Arsenal. When successful, put up to # random cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is equal to the number of Submissions and face-down cards in your Ring.

name: That... Is Undisputed!
Text: Draw 1 card and shuffle up to 1 RFG card (except Divine Intervention) into your Arsenal. During your turn when this card is not in your Backlash or Ring, you may discard 2 cards, and then put it in your Backlash and end your turn. ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Backlash and then choose 1: shuffle up to 4 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, or RFG up to 4 cards in your hand and reveal the same number of Superstar cards. End your turn.

name: The Bad Apples
Text: Arsenal Search Spit at Opponent, draw up to 2 cards, and your opponent puts 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. Your Spit At Opponent are Superstar-specific. When you overturn I Know Cool... And You're Not Cool, put that card into your Ring, and it is Permanent.

name: The Baddest Team on God's Green
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. When playing the NXT Tag Team Title Belts, replace a Superstar on that card with your Superstar, and when it is in your Ring, you are considered a Tag Team for your card effects. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may RFG 1 reversal in your hand, and then your next non-Unique reversal played this turn is -4F.

name: The Bar
Text: Cannot be packed when packing Managers or The Great White. Cannot be blanked or prevented from being played. Can be played from Ringside. ACE: Once during each of your turns when playing a Strike or Grapple, you may overturn 2 cards and then when you are Sheamus, your maneuver is -3F for every maneuver in your Backstage OR when you are Cesaro, your maneuver cannot be reversed by hybrid reversals, and when it is unsuccessful and you have 5F-, put it under your Superstar. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: The Bar's Tandem Attack
Text: Requirement: The Bar is in your Ring. When played, you may choose Grapple or Submission; if you do, this card is the chosen maneuver type instead of Strike for the rest of the turn. ACE: When playing a Superstar-specific maneuver, you may discard 1 maneuver and then your played maneuver is +5D and +1 Stun Value.

name: The Constable
Text: As an action, this card is -4F. Choose 1: put up to 3 non-maneuver cards from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside; OR look at his hand, choose 1 card, and he discards the chosen card. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique card, and then search his hand and Arsenal for cards with the same title, and put them into his Ringside; he shuffles.

name: The Fashion Files
Text: This card is also considered to be The Selfie Stick and Managed by Summer Rae for your effects; cards put under this card are put face-down, regardless of other effects, and cannot be turned face-up. You may play maneuvers from under this card as if from hand; when you do, you may put 2- other cards under this card into your Ringside; when you move at least 1, when you have lower Fortitude your played maneuver can only be reversed from hand or Arsenal, when you move 2, it can only be reversed by D: 0 reversal cards.

name: The Fashion Police
Text: When you are Fandango and this card is overturned from Arsenal, you may put it into your Ring. Your opponent must Promo: 3, then put 2 random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal and draw 1 card.When this card is in your Ring, your Fandango-specific non-hybrid reversals can also reverse a hybrid maneuver.

name: The Fiend
Text: During your turn, your RFG maneuvers without 'reverse' in the text and your RFG Superstar-specific cards can be played as if from hand. When you would apply 8D- from your opponent's maneuver, you may instead RFG the top 4 cards of your Arsenal and end his turn. You can only move RFG cards with Superstar-specific effects. You can pack Bray Wyatt-specific maneuvers, Mandible Claw, and No Sell Maneuver (discard 1 less for its effect). You cannot pack Counterproductive Ambitions, Wrestlemania, or Allegiances.

name: The Fiend’s Lantern
Text: When your opponent plays a Multi card, you may put 2 of your RFG maneuvers under this card, and his card is no longer Multi until the end of the turn. His non-F: 0 cards are +1F for every card under this card. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG up to 2 cards from the top of your Arsenal, and then choose 1: Put that many cards from under this card on the bottom of your Arsenal, or if you removed 2 cards, put 1 RFG card (except Divine Intervention) on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The Finest My Mama's Money Could Buy
Text: This card is also considered a non-Unique Grapple maneuver with 'power' in the title for your effects. When this card is in your Ring, when you successfully play an action, you may Promo: 2.

name: The Firefly Fun House
Text: When you are Bray Wyatt, your Starting Hand Size is +3. When you RFG a Superstar-specific card for your Ability, you may put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal instead (when you are The Fiend, into your hand instead). Your opponent must overturn 2 cards to play a card with the same title as a card in your Ring.

name: The First Lady of WWE
Text: Cannot be blanked. When your first 'Lady' card played during your turn is unsuccessful, RFG 1 card in your opponent's Ringside, and he puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal; when you have 6+ cards under your Superstar card, double those numbers. When you would RFG your 'Lady' card, you may overturn 1 card and put it under your Superstar card instead. ACE: During your turn, you may put Skirt the Issue or The Women's Evolution from your Ring into your Ringside and put 1 non-Superstar-specific card from your opponent's Ring into his Ringside.

name: The First Three-Time Divas Champion
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +3. You may put WWE Divas Championship Title from your Backlash or Ringside into your Ring. Your opponent must overturn 3 cards to reverse a maneuver with 'diva' in the text. ACE: When you have lower Fortitude and your card with 'diva' or 'female' in the text is successful, it is considered to be a maneuver for your maneuvers; when it is unsuccessful and you have F: 3-, you may overturn 3 cards and put it into your Ring face-down.

name: The Fish Hook
Text: As a maneuver, when you are Bobby Fish this card is +5D and +1 Stun Value, and when successful Arsenal Search Maintain Hold. If it is your next card played this turn, ignore the “Can only be played...” text. As a reversal, reverse any Submission. When Bobby Fish is revealed, can also completely reverse any Multi card.

name: The Flamed Wonder
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude and your maneuver with Stun Value is unsuccessful, you may put this card from your Ringside or Backlash into your Ring. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique maneuver or any Unique Action. When this card is in your Ring: your 'Classic' maneuvers are +1 Stun Value; and when you have lower Fortitude, you may discard 1 card instead of RFG for your Ability, and when your maneuver with Stun Value is unsuccessful, put up to 1 RFG non-reversal card into your hand.

name: The Four Horsewomen of MMA
Text: When your opponent has F: 10+ more than you, this card counts as two reversals and his effects cannot prevent you from playing it.

name: The Future is... IIconic!
Text: Cannot be reversed when This is the Future is in your Ring. Arsenal / Ringside Search 1 IICONICS!. When this card is in your Ring, choose both options for From Sydney, Australia.

name: The Ghetto Drop
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -6F and when played after a Set-up card, can only be reversed by Unique cards. As a reversal, reverse any non-Unique Strike or non-Unique Grapple.

name: The Iconic Duo
Text: You can pack 11 copies of IICONICS! in your Backstage but you cannot pack them in your Arsenal. Before your first Draw Segment of the game, put 1 of those cards into your hand and shuffle the other copies into your Arsenal. They do not count as Superstar-specific for Not On My Broadcast!. When you have 11 printed copies of IICONICS! in your Ring, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: The Iiconics
Text: Once per game, during your turn you may overturn 11 cards and shuffle 11 cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal. After damage has been applied from your opponent's 11D+ card, you may discard 2 cards and end his turn. You cannot pack 11D+ cards.

name: The King of the Cruiserweights
Text: Cannot be blanked, and can be played during any Pre-match phase. When NXT Arrival is not in your Ring: 205 Live is also considered to be NXT Arrival for your effects, you may look at the cards under it, and replace 'put any cards' with 'put 2+ cards'. Replace 'X-Pac' with 'Neville' on Cruiserweight Title Belt.

name: The Last Shot
Text: When Panama Sunrise is in your Ring, the damage of this card cannot be reduced. When you have 5+ Adam Cole-specific cards in your Ring, cannot be reversed from Backlash or Arsenal.

name: The Master Technician of the Undisputed Era
Text: During your turn, when you would draw for The NXT Breakout Star, you may instead Arsenal / Ringside Search 1 'Breaker' maneuver. Your first maneuver each turn is +1D and -1F for each 'Breaker' or 'Tech' card in your Ring. When your 9D- maneuver is successful, put up to 1 card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: The Mechanics
Text: When packing this card, your ‘Blindside’ maneuvers are not Fan Favorite, and they are considered Chain for your effects; you can pack 3 Ready to Fight in your Backstage, and they can be played from Backstage. During your first Draw Segment, draw 2- additional cards. Ignore the ’When...partner’ text on your Tag reversals. When you would RFG cards for playing a ‘Blindside’ maneuver, you may instead put 1 Tag card or 1 card with 'tag team' in the text from your Ring under this card. Your maneuvers are +2D and +1 Stun Value for every 3 cards under this card.

name: The Messiah of the Back Breaker
Text: When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring and you may Promo: 2. When this card is in your Ring your 'Breaker' maneuvers are Multi and +5D and you may double the numbers in the text of your Back Breaker and Rib Breaker.

name: The Miz-tourage
Text: Cannot be blanked.  Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. When you play a 'Bo' or 'Ax' Maneuver as a Counter, it is +1D and ignore the 'Can only be played...' text; when you have lower Fortitude, choose 1: it is Multi, or it is -3F. ACE: When your 'Bo' or 'Ax' maneuver is unsuccessful, you may flip 2 'Bo' or 'Ax' cards in your Ring face down, and then your turn continues, but your next card played this turn can only be a 'Bo' or 'Ax' card; it is blank and after it is resolved, end your turn.

name: The Most Dominant Woman in NXT
Text: Cannot be reversed. When you are Asuka, F: 0. When this card is unsuccessful, Recover 5- Ringside cards, draw 2-, and your opponent discards 2. In Ring: your 'Choke' maneuvers and maneuvers listed on your Superstar-specific Backstage cards are +3D and +1 Stun. In Ringside: during your turn, you may Eliminate 1 'Women' Title Belt and put this card into your Backlash.

name: The Most Iiconic Moment
Text: Double the numbers in the text of your WWE Women's Tag Team Title Belts. Once during your turn, when you successfully play a maneuver or a Unique action, Ringside Search 1 IICONICS!. ACE: When he plays a non-Unique maneuver you may put up to 3 IICONICS! from your Ring into your Ringside. When you moved 1, reverse a 4D- maneuver. When you moved 2, reverse a 7D- maneuver. When you moved 3, reverse the maneuver.

name: The Quarter-Ton Titan
Text: At the end of the Pre-match phase, Arsenal Search 2 non-Unique non-hybrid maneuvers. During your first turn, your opponent reveals his hand; choose 1 card and he shuffles the chosen card into his Arsenal. When you have 8F+ and he plays a maneuver, you may hide this card and his maneuver is considered either Irish Whip, Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, or Gut Wrench for your cards.

name: The Queen of Spades
Text: Cannot be blanked or moved from your Ring; does not take up a Ring slot. At the end of the Pre-match phase, you may put Drawing a Blank from your Backlash into your Ring, that card is now Superstar-specific. ACE: When you have F:12-, you may RFG this card and then Arsenal Search 2- Submissions. ACE: When you have F:12+ and your opponent plays a maneuver, you may flip this card face down and then blank their card this turn.

name: The Queen's Army
Text: Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of Submissions and face-down cards in your Ring (max 8). When this card is unsuccessful and your opponent played 1- cards in response to it, you may put it into your hand instead of any other location and then shuffle up to 4 cards from Ringside and up to 3 RFG cards into your Arsenal.

name: The Salt Ceremony
Text: When packing this card, you may pack No Sell Maneuver and an additional 15 cards in your Arsenal. Your Fortitude is considered +10F for Mr. Fuji's Cane. When your maneuver is affected by Managed by Mr. Fuji, your opponent must overturn 3 cards in order to reverse it from hand, Backlash, or Ringside.

name: The Scottish Psychopath
Text: When your first maneuver played each turn is not printed F: 1, printed D: 1, or Chain, and it does not have 'can only be reversed' or 'cannot be reversed' in the text, it is +1D; when that maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it and up to 1 random card from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal; when it is successful, choose one: draw up to 1 card or your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: The Strowman Express
Text: When you have lower Fortitude or fewer cards in hand, and your opponent's Fortitude Rating is 5+, your reversals are -#F, where # is equal to the Stun Value in your Ring. His non-maneuver cards are considered actions for your reversals. When you play a reversal or Superstar-specific card with more than one logo, discard cards equal to the number of Superstar-specific card with more than one logo in your Ring.

name: The Submission Magician
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may flip a Submission in your Ring face down. If you do, your next maneuver played from hand this turn is considered to be a Submission with blank text, and after damage is applied, end your turn. If it is unsuccessful, you may put it in your hand regardless of other effects or flip a card in your Ring face up. Replace a Superstar on your NXT Women's Championship Belt with Shayna Baszler and ignore 'When you are an NXT Superstar'.

name: The Symbol of Excellence
Text: When packing this card, you may pack any number of The Four Horseman-specific Backlash cards in your Backstage, they can be played during any phase, and when you reveal this card, put them into your Backlash. Your Pre-match Capacity is +4, and your opponent cannot prevent you from playing Title Belts. Ignore ‘non-maneuver’ on your non-hybrid Superstar-specific cards. You are also considered the Brain Busters for your effects during the Pre-match phase. When you have 4- cards in hand or 4+ lower Fortitude: draw 1 additional card for your Ability, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are Trademark Finishers instead, and when your maneuver is unsuccessful, he overturns 4 cards.

name: The V.I.P. Lounge
Text: Your The Players Club cannot be blanked, and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, ignore 'randomly' in the text. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you have lower Fortitude, and there are 0 MVP-specific Pre-match cards in your Ring: you may put 1 MVP-specific Pre-match card from your Ringside into your Ring.

name: The YES! Movement
Text: Cannot be packed when packing 'A.J.' cards. Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +2. When you successfully play a 4D+ maneuver without 'reverse' or 'reversal' in the text, you may Arsenal Search 1 non-hybrid maneuver of a different type; when it is unsuccessful, Ringside Search 1 non-hybrid non-Unique maneuver of a different type.

name: THIS IS AWESOME!
Text: Can only be packed when packing We Are Not Your Kind. Cannot be packed when packing Wrestlemania. During your turn when this card is in your Backlash or Ringside and all players have F: 25+, you may put this card into your Ring, and then all players shuffle up to 5 Unique cards from their Ringside into their Arsenal, and each NXT Superstar may put 1 Unique maneuver from their Ringside into their hand.

name: This is the Future
Text: Your opponent can only play 1 reversal to this card. Arsenal / Ringside Search The Future is... IIconic! ACE: During your turn, you may put this card into your Ringside and your next card played is -11F.

name: Throat-Cutting Taunt
Logos: Bobby Fish, The Phenom, The Last Outlaw, Dangerous Alliance
Text: As an action, this card is -5F. Draw up to 2 cards and your opponent puts 1 card from hand on the bottom of his Arsenal. When you are Bobby Fish, your opponent cannot respond to this card; when he successfully plays a maneuver you may put this card from your Ring on the bottom of your Arsenal.

name: Through the Raw Announce Table
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Raw This card is considered non-Unique for your Raw card effects. Can only be played after a successful maneuver or if Roll Out of the Ring is in any Ring.

name: Title Belt Air Guitar
Logos: Kyle O'Reilly, Hollywood Hogan, Undisputed Era
Text: When you are an NXT Superstar, this card is NXT. When you are Kyle O'Reilly, your Starting Hand Size is +2 and this card cannot be blanked. When you have a Title Belt in your Ring your Starting Hand Size is +2 and your Pre-match Capacity is +1. When you discard or overturn a Superstar-specific maneuver for your Superstar Ability you may put that card on the bottom of your Arsenal instead.

name: Topé Suicida
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: NXT When High-Flying Style is in your Ring, you may play this card from your Ringside. Can only be played after a successful 2D+ maneuver.  When High-Flying Style in your Ring, can only be played after a successful card. Put up to # RFG cards on the bottom of your Arsenal, where # is half the number of NXT cards in your Ring, rounded down.

name: Twisted Arm Stomp
Text: When played as a Counter, can only be reversed by 2 reversals. When played after a 'Choke' or 'Finger' maneuver, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash. Your opponent discards cards equal to the number of 'Arm' maneuvers in your Ring.

name: Undisputed Era
Text: You may pack Adam Cole, Bobby Fish, Kyle O’Reilly, and Roderick Strong hidden in your Backstage. When you completely reverse a maneuver from your hand or Backlash, you may discard 1 card, reveal up to 1 hidden Superstar card, and then Promo: 4. When your opponent successfully plays a 4D+ maneuver, hide 1 other revealed Superstar. Before each Draw Segment, you may choose a revealed Superstar in your Backstage, and add their ability to yours until the end of the turn. You are a Tag Team.

name: Vader or... The British Bulldog?
Text: When packing this card, you can pack As Big and Tough as Any Two Men and No Sell Maneuver. ≥ Hand Size: +7 Superstar Value: +4 Superstar Ability: +When your maneuver is reversed from hand, draw cards up to the reversed maneuver's printed Stun Value. Your non-Multi 'Clothesline', 'Lariat', 'Punch', and 'Slam' maneuvers are considered to have 'Power' in the title; Your 'Power' maneuvers are -2F for each 'Power' maneuver in your Ringside. ≥ Hand Size: +6 Superstar Value: +3 Superstar Ability: +Your first 2 non-Unique Grapples played each turn are Multi. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 Backlash card in your Ring, and then shuffle up to 3 Grapples from your Ringside into your Arsenal.

name: Vickie's Ringside Interruption
Text: This card is +1D for every Smackdown card in your Ring. When this card is in your Ringside or RFG, and you unsuccessfully play a card, you may put this into your hand.

name: Victorious Villany
Text: Replace 'maneuver' with 'High Risk maneuver' in your Ability. Your maneuvers are +2D, your Samoan Drop cards are considered to have 'Classic' in the title for your effects. Your opponent must discard 1 card to reverse your Unique maneuvers from hand or Backlash; when your Unique maneuver is unsuccessful, Ringside Search 1 other Unique card.

name: Vince McBossman
Text: When successful, your opponent's Ability is blank until the start of your next turn. ACE: You may put this card into your opponent's Backstage to reverse any action played from hand. When this card is in your Backstage and you have greater cards in hand, overturn 1 card to play an action.

name: WCW's Technical Shooter
Text: Packed: you can pack Drawing a Blank in your Backstage and it counts as having '1000' in the title. You also count as The Radicalz for your card effects, and replace 'Arsenal' with 'Ringside' on your Ring Psychology: Leg. Do not RFG cards for The Iceman Cometh, your Superstar-specific cards count as non-Unique for that card's effect, and when you play a non-Foreign Object maneuver without a printed reversal restriction 'as if from hand', you may blank that card this turn.

name: We Are Not Your Kind
Text: When packing this card you cannot pack Raw, Smackdown, Classic WWF, ECW, WCW, or nWo cards, From NXT to WWE, or NXT Arrival. Your NXT Mid-match and non-Object NXT Pre-match cards do not take up slots in your Ring. ACE: When your NXT Mid-match card is unsuccessful, you may discard 2 cards and then put it into your Backlash regardless of other effects.

name: We ARE The Bar!
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 D: 0 reversals. When your opponent has greater cards in hand, he puts random cards from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal until he has the same number of cards in hand. When The Bar is in your Ring, his 8D+ Multi maneuvers played are 7D.

name: We Don't Set the Bar
Text: When The Bar is in your Ring, this card is -10F. Reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver played from hand, or when The Bar is in your Ring, reverse any maneuver played from hand. Your opponent puts the reversed card on the bottom of his Arsenal, regardless of other effects.ACE: When The Bar is in your Ring and he plays a non-Superstar-specific maneuver, you may discard 2 cards, and his maneuver is Multi.

name: We're Really Glad That You're Our Friend!
Text: When successful, put this card into your opponent's Backstage. When he is Bray Wyatt and he successfully plays a The Fiend-specific card, he may Ringside Search 1 card. When he is The Fiend and you have 2+ The Fiend-specific cards in your Backstage, before each of your Draw Segments you may RFG 1 random card in your Ringside. If you do not, he may put 1 random RFG non-maneuver card on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: Welcome to the Uso Penitentiary
Text: Your opponent's Starting Hand Size is -1, his maneuvers are -1D, and your maneuvers are +1D. When you play a High Risk without 'reversed' in the text after a maneuver listed in your Ability, it cannot be reversed from hand by non-Unique reversals. When his card moves a card from his Ringside to his Arsenal, and you have fewer cards in hand, put up to 1 non-hybrid card with a title listed in your Ability from your Ringside into your hand.

name: What Lies Within
Text: Can only be reversed by D: 1 cards. Arsenal / Ringside Search 1 card, put that card under I Dream Broken Dreams, and shuffle. Your opponent chooses 1: he puts 1 random card under another card in his Ring into his Ringside, he puts 1 random card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, or you may RFG 1 card in his Ring.

name: White Noise
Text: Your opponent's reversals to this card are blank until the end of the turn. When The Bar is not in your Ring, draw up to 1 card. When this card is in your Ring and your opponent plays a non-Superstar-specific maneuver, he chooses 1: he puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal, or his card is blank.'

name: Wilder's Blindside Punch
Text: If you have lower Fortitude, can be played from Ringside. If you have equal or greater Fortitude, RFG 1 card from your hand and 1 card from your Ringside. Cannot be reversed by hybrids. As an action, put this card on the bottom of your Arsenal and put up to 2 RFG 'Blindside' cards into your Ringside.

name: Willow's Bell
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F; when you have 30F+ this card is a Trademark Finisher instead and +5D. When you have 10+ cards under The Sicilian Psychopath, cannot be reversed from hand or Backlash by non Superstar-specific reversal cards. As a reversal, reverse any card with 'Ringside' in the title or text. Your opponent discards half the cards in his hand (rounded down).

name: Winning at All Costs
Text: When packing this card, you may pack up to 4 Heel maneuvers, 5 Heel reversals, and 4 Heel actions in your Backstage; when this card is revealed, reveal those cards and shuffle them into your Arsenal. You may pack El Kabong but you cannot pack Quick Count Ref. During your turn when you have lower Fortitude, or when you would lose the game by Pinfall Victory, you may put Playin' a Mean Tune from any area at the bottom of your Arsenal, hide this card and shuffle up to 4 RFG cards and up to 5 cards in your Ringside into your Arsenal, draw up to 4 cards, and the game continues.

name: WWE Women's Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. At the end of the Pre-match phase, draw 1 card and put 1 card from your hand and up to 1 card in your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When you are Alexa Bliss, Asuka, Bayley, Nikki Cross, Kairi Sane, Sasha Banks, or the IIconics, draw up to 2 cards instead. Superstar Value +0

name: X-Plex
Text: This card is considered to have 'Suplex' in the title for your effects. Can be played from Ringside; if you do, discard 1 card. When played from hand, -5F.

name: Yokozuna's Nerve Hold
Text: As a maneuver, when played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from hand. As a reversal, can be played as if it is D: 0. When successful, your opponent discards 1 random card, and your next maneuver played cannot be reversed.

name: Yokozuna's Savate Kick
Text: As a maneuver, draw up to 2 cards and your opponent discards 2 cards. As a reversal, reverse any action or Grapple. As an action, this card is -10F; put this card and up to 2 cards from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When successful, Arsenal Search 1 card.

name: You Don't Want to Play Me
Text: You may pack this card as if it is not Heat. During your turn, you may discard this card and put 1 non-hybrid maneuver from your Ringside on the bottom of your Arsenal. When this card is in your Backlash and your opponent plays I Want to Play the Game, reveal this card, look at his Backlash, and choose 1 card. He may discard all copies of that card. If he does not, he must choose this card for I Want to Play the Game. When this card is in your Backlash and your opponent plays In The Interest of Fairness, put this card into your Ring. When you move cards from your hand for his In The Interest of Fairness, you may draw 1 card.

name: You Have The Right to Remain Stylish
Text: Can be played from under another card as if from hand. Cannot be reversed from hand. Shuffle any number of cards from your hand and up to the same number of cards from your Ringside into your Arsenal, and draw the same number of cards; draw 1 additional card when Breezango is in your Ring. When your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may put it under The Fashion Files.

name: You're Gonna Get These Hands!
Text: Your non-Chain, non-Volley, non-RMS 'Fist', 'Hook', 'Uppercut', 'Haymaker', or 'Jab' Strikes are considered to have 'Punch' in the title. Your 'Punch' Strikes are +2D. When you have lower Fortitude and your 'Punch' Strike is unsuccessful, you may put 1 other 'Punch' Strike from your Ringside into your hand, and your opponent puts 1 card from his hand on the bottom of his Arsenal.

name: You're Just Developmental
Text: Cannot be packed by an NXT Superstar or when packing I'm Gonna Break You. Before the Draw Segment of his first turn, your opponent discards 1 card for every 2 non-Superstar-specific NXT cards in his Ring. ACE: During his turn, when he successfully plays a non-Trademark Finisher NXT card, you may overturn 2 cards and RFG this card, and then choose 1: Reduce that card's damage to 0 or resolve a copy of the card's effects after your opponent does.

name: Young and Bitter
Text: As an action, shuffle up to 2 RFG cards  into your Arsenal. When successfully played, draw up to # cards and your opponent discards #, where # is half the number of Split Finger Lock cards in your Ring (rounded up).

name: Your Trash is My Treasure
Text: Can only be played when That's Value is in your Ring. When played, if you have 3+ cards in your Ring and/or Ringside with card titles listed on That's Value, reverse any non-Unique card (when you have 6+ cards, reverse any card). Shuffle up to 5 cards printed on That's Value from your Ringside into your Arsenal and Arsenal Search 2 cards with the same title listed on That's Value.

name: Yowie Wowie!
Text: Reverse any non-Unique maneuver (when you are Bray Wyatt, instead reverse any card). When this card reverses from any area, put it into your opponent's Backstage.
